name: @omt/cli
description: One More Token: local dashboard for AI coding agent usage (omt start | serve | ingest | watch)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @omt/web build && rm -rf dist web-dist data migrations && mkdir -p dist web-dist && cp -R ../../data data && cp -R ../../packages/core/migrations migrations && cp -R ../web/dist/. web-dist/ && esbuild src/entry-npm.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main.js --external:@duckdb/* --external:sqlite3 && node scripts/pack-shebang.mjs && chmod +x dist/main.js
